name: Four Seasons Resort Tamarindo
insider_take: This Pacific coast sanctuary sits on one of Costa Rica's most pristine stretches of coastline, where luxury meets the wild beauty of Guanacaste Province.
whats_special: The resort occupies a spectacular peninsula overlooking Tamarindo Bay, offering both sunrise and sunset ocean views - a rare geographic gift. The property features Costa Rica's first Four Seasons golf course designed by Arnold Palmer, carved into dramatic clifftops with holes that practically hang over the Pacific. The resort also sits adjacent to Las Baulas National Marine Park, a critical nesting ground for endangered leatherback sea turtles.
pro_tip: Book your stay between October and March for prime turtle nesting season - the resort offers guided nighttime tours to witness these ancient giants come ashore to lay their eggs.
dont_miss: The Langosta Beach estuary mangrove tour at sunset, where you'll spot crocodiles, monkeys, and over 180 bird species. Also experience the resort's unique "Pura Vida" spa treatment that incorporates locally-sourced volcanic mud and coffee scrubs from nearby plantations.
pros: Exceptional beachfront location on Costa Rica's Pacific coast
Outstanding dining experiences with local cuisine
Legendary Four Seasons service and attention to detail
cons: Remote location requiring extended travel time
